name: Stonks
author: Gaurav Chande
description: A stock ticker and watchlist for your bar: a bull on up days, a bear on down, and a day chart you can scrub, smooth or retro. It follows stocks on markets around the world, and US ones through pre-market, after-hours, and overnight trading. Prices come from Yahoo Finance and Robinhood.

barWidget.description: Today's move for your stocks, with a chart a click away.

schema.label: Pill
schema.description: How the pill looks in the centre or left section of a top or bottom bar. Middle-click the pill to change it.

schema.label: Pill on the right
schema.description: How the pill looks in the right section of a top or bottom bar, among the bar's icons. Middle-click the pill there to change it.

schema.label: Pill on a side bar
schema.description: How the pill looks on a bar at the side of the screen: Stonks' mark, or the symbol over its change. Middle-click the pill there to switch.
